content:
thought
The Anthracnose reference image (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg) shows a young, brownish leaf with significant damage and holes, which does not visually match the green leaf with distinct spots in the test image.

Now I will view a reference image for Die_Back.

thought
The Die_Back reference image (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg) shows a completely shriveled and dried-up leaf, which is very different from the green leaf with spots in the test image.

Next, I will view a reference image for Powdery_Mildew.

thought
The Powdery_Mildew reference image (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg) shows a leaf covered with white, powdery patches, which is not consistent with the dark spots on the test image.

Finally for the first round, I will view a reference image for Sooty_Mould.

thought
The Sooty_Mould reference image (Mango_Leaf_147.jpg) shows a leaf covered with black, splotchy, and somewhat textured patches, which bears some resemblance to the dark, irregular spots on the test image, particularly in color and general appearance of irregular dark patches. This seems like the most promising candidate so far.

I have used 4 out of 8 reference image views. I have viewed one from each class. Now I will revisit Sooty_Mould to see more reference images, as it is the most similar.

thought
The second Sooty_Mould reference image (Mango_Leaf_164.jpg) shows a mango leaf with dark, almost brown-black, smudged areas, consistent with the sooty mold appearance, and is quite similar to the test image's irregular dark spots. This further strengthens Sooty_Mould as the primary candidate.

I have used 5 out of 8 reference image views. I will now view another Sooty_Mould image.

thought
The third Sooty_Mould reference image (Mango_Leaf_288.jpg) also shows irregular dark spots on a leaf, although this leaf is older and more discolored than the test image. The black spots are very similar in appearance to those on the test image.

I have used 6 out of 8 reference image views. Since Sooty_Mould consistently matches the test image, I will use my remaining 2 views to re-examine other classes to ensure there isn't a better match I missed. I will look at another Anthracnose image, as the first one was quite damaged and might not be representative.
